summary: Shinhan Financial Group filed a Form 6-K disclosing its board's October 13, 2026 resolution to acquire 239,082,287 common shares, or 77.04%, of Lotte Non-Life Insurance for KRW 693,338,632,300 in cash, making it a subsidiary to enhance group competitiveness. The amount equals 1.15% of Shinhan's KRW 60.37tn equity capital and remains subject to adjustment at closing. The scheduled acquisition date is undetermined, pending regulatory approvals. This finalizes clarifications from June 29 and July 28, 2026 responding to media rumors. Watch Korean regulatory timing, minority squeeze-out and integration risk; no premium or advisor was disclosed.
